culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Dress and behaviour codes are conservative. Take care not to offend. If you're a woman, wear clothing that covers your knees. FSM Embassy visitor guide: dress modestly; women cover their thighs in public, and swimwear is only for swimming, boats or poolside. Ask before entering villages, beaches or other private land, and use local guides at cultural sites.
